items.description:

items.title: Pakistan's mythologised idea of an all-rounder finds a home in Arafat Minhas
items.description:
Pakistan has developed somewhat of a gluttony for all-rounders. And it makes sense.
As cricket has evolved, we have increasingly been assessing players and performances based on utility, impact and numbers, instead of drawing decontextualised conclusions based on skill alone.
It is important to be good, yes, as it always has been. But now, being good simply isn’t enough – the real question is: you may be good, but are you also useful?

items.title: 10 killed, 44 injured as passenger bus overturns on highway in Punjab's Rajanpur
items.description:
DERA GHAZI KHAN: Ten people were killed and 44 others injured when a passenger bus overturned after hitting a road divider on the Indus Highway in Rajanpur district’s Rojhan tehsil, Rescue 1122 said.
The accident occurred in the Bangla Hidayat area at around 5:45am. The bus was reportedly speeding when it collided with the divider and toppled over.
The deceased include seven men, two women and a girl, Rescue 1122 said in an incident report.

items.title: Profit rates on National Savings schemes increased from Oct 21
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: The government has increased profit rates on several national savings schemes, including those for pensioners, senior citizens and families of martyrs, with the revised rates taking effect from October 21.
According to the revised schedule issued by the Central Directorate of National Savings (CDNS), the profit rate on Behbood Savings Certificates, Pensioners’ Benefit Accounts and Shuhada’s Family Welfare Accounts has been raised to 12.96 per cent from 12.72pc.

items.title: State of deceased’s eyes not proof of ‘unwitnessed’ death: SC
items.description:
• Court dismisses petitions challenging double-murder convictions
• Verdict explains that closing eyes of a corpse is ‘religious’ custom, not legal duty
